parameters.query: SELECT (r.tool_id IS NOT NULL) AS found, r.status AS tool_status, r.risk_class_default::text AS registry_class, r.external_effect, coalesce($1 = ANY (r.allowed_contexts), false) AS context_allowed, (SELECT max(o.min_risk_class)::text FROM jarvis_ops.context_risk_override o WHERE o.context_id = $1 AND (o.tool_id = $2 OR o.action_type = $4)) AS override_class FROM (SELECT 1) AS eins LEFT JOIN jarvis_ops.tool_registry r ON r.tool_id = $2 AND r.version = $3

SELECT (r.tool_id IS NOT NULL) AS found, r.status AS tool_status, r.risk_class_default::text AS registry_class, r.external_effect, coalesce($1 = ANY (r.allowed_contexts), false) AS context_allowed, (SELECT max(o.min_risk_class)::text FROM jarvis_ops.context_risk_override o WHERE o.context_id = $1 AND (o.tool_id = $2 OR o.action_type = $4)) AS override_class FROM (SELECT 1) AS eins LEFT JOIN jarvis_ops.tool_registry r ON r.tool_id = $2 AND r.version = $3
